notes: At least four actual forward steps, two per foot, with one continuously integrated free base; no mid-run pose reset or base forces.
The stance slip metric includes foot rotation through every source sole outline vertex; origin is first actually loaded sample in that planned stance.
Saturation is measured from actual actuator force at every integration step, including startup.
Clearance and slip are sampled every 20 ms; numerical joint interval envelopes separately support CAD interference checks.
Passing these checks does not qualify hardware, friction, measured motor capacity, thermal performance or material compliance.
